description: Leads captured through a tool page's execute flow, newest first, cursor-paginated. short {id,email,createdAt}; medium adds source, lastToolRunId, lastToolInputs; full = raw (includes lastToolResult).

cursor.description: A lead id from the previous call's nextCursor, to continue.

detail.description: Verbosity of returned item(s): "short" = id + primary label + status (cheap list scan); "medium" = key summary fields + counts (a useful glance); "full" = the complete object. Default "short". Lists default to "short" — to zoom into one item, call its get/view tool with detail="medium" or "full".

name: tool_leads
